study: Study 2: redesign of each architecture's 3 mm design for 5, 7 and 9 mm pads (2D side model)

report/study2/data/raw/redesign.csv.rows: one per (architecture, required flexion, target thickness): the two ends of the Pareto front of coverage against contact-surface change

report/study2/data/redesign_fronts.csv.rows: every point of every front (already committed; not copied)

definitions.d_contact: Δ_contact: largest change over flexion of the distal contact point's path, seen from the proximal pad face, between the 3 mm design and the redesign; stored as a fraction of the finger length, converted here with L_f = 90 mm
definitions.fixed_axis_bound_mm: lowest Δ_contact a fixed-axis joint can reach for this thickness change, 2 sin(q_req/2) Δh
definitions.d_contact_at_most_c_pad_mm / most_c_pad: the coverage end of the front (the design reported)
definitions.least_d_contact_mm / c_pad_at_least_d_co: the other end of the front
definitions.study1_c_pad: Study 1's best coverage at the target thickness
